name: Simplified for Swofty
author: Team Simplified
description: Mods convert into Swofty addons using the Simplified Importer: any F1 25 mod, from a zip, 7z, rar or folder, including mods made with Simplified Studio and track zips

commands.name: mods
commands.about: Mods in the Simplified Importer's library, the addons made from them, and the order of those not converted

subcommands.name: list
subcommands.about: List the library in load order

subcommands.name: import
subcommands.about: Import mods and turn each into a Swofty addon

args.name: path
args.help: A mod's zip, 7z, rar or folder, laid out like the game folder

subcommands.name: remove
subcommands.about: Delete a mod from the library; its addon stays

subcommands.name: enable
subcommands.about: Turn a mod that was not converted on in the profile

subcommands.name: disable
subcommands.about: Turn a mod that was not converted off in the profile

subcommands.name: move
subcommands.about: Move a mod that was not converted to a place in its load order (1 loads first)
